messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Edge façade (edge-facade) 5xx spike detected for api.redwood.com — 5m 502 rate 9.4% (threshold 2%). Severity P1. Affected regions: us-west-2. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/edge-facade?from=now-10m. Runbook: https://wiki.internal/infra/edge-502s. Pager: SRE-oncall.

maya (oncall): acknowledged. i'm in. creating a temporary control-room thread. @Tom H @Eric L please triage. i’ll start verifying traffic patterns + recent deploys.

Tom H: on it. looking at ingress logs now. quick check — any recent config pushes to our edge nginx pool?

ingress-bot: Deploy detected: edge-proxy-usw2 v2026.3.18 at 2024-11-17T14:12:05Z by ci-bot.

Eric L: i’m pulling proxy logs + upstream health. initial grep shows surge of "504 upstream timeout" then 502s. suspect upstream app timeout causing backend to respond 502s. sample tail: 
```
[2024-11-17T14:16:42Z] edge-proxy: upstream_resp=502 backend=svc-models-02 path=/v1/generate rt=1203ms
[2024-11-17T14:16:43Z] edge-proxy: upstream_resp=504 backend=svc-models-03 path=/v1/generate rt=30000ms
```

Priya S (prod-ops): customer-impact check: internal SLOs show error budget burn for synth tests + several customer requests failing in us-west. estimating ~1.8k failed requests last 5m, top impacted API: /v1/generate.

maya (oncall): thanks. can we isolate by region? route traffic to other regions if capacity available. also, enable immediate retry fallback to a smaller model for affected endpoints to reduce backend latency.

Tom H: routing check — we have spare capacity in us-east-1 but model versions don't match exactly. will run canary reroute for 10% to us-east now. command: `route-control shift --src edge-facade-usw2 --dst edge-facade-use1 --pct 10`

Tom H: executed — 10% shifted. monitoring error rate.

Eric L: running quick mitigation on upstream: increase backend timeout from 30s -> 60s temporarily to see if we convert 504->502 less. patch applied to proxy pool. config snippet: `proxy_read_timeout 60s;`

maya (oncall): note — longer timeouts may tie up connections; watch connection counts. if we see head-of-line blocking we revert.

ingress-bot: Autoscaler event: svc-models pool scaling triggered +5 pods in us-west-2 at 14:19:03Z.

Priya S: customer comms: high-level impact message prepared for status page. ETA to post 5m after stabilization.

Tom H: after 10% shift and timeout increase, 502 rate dropped to 6.1% in 3m. continuing. increasing shift to 30%. `route-control shift --src edge-facade-usw2 --dst edge-facade-use1 --pct 30`

Eric L: investigating root cause: recent deploy (v2026.3.18) introduced a change in the model worker thread pool that increases cold-start latency under burst. reproducing locally.

maya (oncall): hold further broad rollbacks — we need confidence. Plan: keep routing shift, scale backend, engage devs for hotfix. @Priya prepare incident note for affected customers: mention degraded API performance and active mitigation.

Priya S: drafting and will post to status with tags: incident, edge, 502s.

ingress-bot: Metric update: us-west-2 5m 502 rate = 3.0% after 30% shift and scaling (14:25:00Z).

maya (oncall): good. paging rotation — i'm handing oncall to Tom for next 30 minutes while i coordinate with product and customers. @Tom H you're the incident owner for now.

Tom H: taking over. I’ll keep watchers updated. next steps: 1) keep routing shift at 30% and monitor for 15m, 2) apply hotfix to reduce worker startup latency, 3) prepare rollback if hotfix fails.

Eric L: hotfix branch ready — small change to warm worker pool earlier. applying to one canary pod in us-west-2 now. `kubectl apply -f hotfix-warm-pool.yaml --record`

Eric L: canary looks good, latency drops in canary logs. promoting to remaining pods gradually.

ingress-bot: Canary promote: hotfix-warm-pool rolled to 60% of svc-models-usw2 at 14:33:20Z.

Tom H: monitoring — 502 rate now 0.9% (14:35). starting to roll back routing shift slowly to normal. `route-control shift --src edge-facade-usw2 --dst edge-facade-use1 --pct 15`

maya (oncall): excellent. as we stabilize, keep lifecycle notes for postmortem: timeline of deploy, triggers, mitigation commands, customer impact estimates. Tagging @Eric L for RCA.

Priya S: status page updated: "We experienced elevated 502/504 error rates in US-WEST-2 impacting the generation API. Mitigation steps applied; partial traffic routed to another region and backend hotfix deployed. Errors are decreasing; customers may have seen transient failures between 14:12–14:36 UTC. We continue monitoring."

Tom H: moving to monitoring-only. last action: revert proxy timeout to 30s to avoid connection pile-up: `proxy_read_timeout 30s` — done.

ingress-bot: Incident summary saved to /incidents/1718204321.

maya (oncall): handing back to me at 14:45. Tom, thanks for taking point. We'll schedule a follow-up postmortem meeting tomorrow. Closing control-room once monitoring stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
